verified_facts.text: InterContinental Kuala Lumpur is steps away from the Twin Towers, the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre and shopping and entertainment.
verified_facts.excerpt: InterContinental Kuala Lumpur is steps away from the iconic Twin Towers, Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre and shopping & entertainment activities.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's address is 165 Jalan Ampang, Kuala Lumpur.

verified_facts.text: The hotel lists Ampang Park LRT Station among its public transportation options.

verified_facts.text: Rooms offer a choice of a Super King-sized bed or two super single twin beds, plus a working space with a multi-media hub.
verified_facts.excerpt: Choose from a Super King-sized bed or two super single twin beds and stay productive at the generous working space with a multi-media hub.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have a large marble bathroom with a separate shower and bathtub.
verified_facts.excerpt: Large marble bathroom with a separate shower & bathtub.

verified_facts.text: Guests with access can use the Club InterContinental lounge, which comes with enhanced guest benefits.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elevate your InterContinental experience with exclusive access to the luxurious Club InterContinental lounge, a refined space with an impressive level of hospitality and enhanced guest benefits.

verified_facts.text: The Club InterContinental lounge has a smart casual dress code with appropriate footwear.
verified_facts.excerpt: We appreciate if guests kindly adhere to the Club dress code: smart casual with appropriate footwear when inside the lounge.

verified_facts.text: The outdoor swimming pool is on level 5, surrounded by lush green landscaping, with a pool bar serving cold drinks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on level 5, the swimming pool offers a relaxing sanctuary surrounded by lush green landscape where guests can take a leisurely dip, sunbathe or enjoy a cold beverage served from the pool bar.

verified_facts.text: The outdoor pool is landscaped with lush greenery to feel like an urban oasis.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beautifully landscaped to inspire an experience of an urban oasis with lush greenery, our outdoor pool offers a relaxing sanctuary.

verified_facts.excerpt: Set amidst a relaxing Koi garden with a cascading waterfall, this restaurant offers guests bountiful buffet spreads and an à la carte menu of local and international delicacies.

verified_facts.text: OneSixFive Lounge serves signature Royal High Tea sets with Beef Wellington and pastries, paired with fine teas.
verified_facts.excerpt: The lounge also features its signature Royal High Tea sets with Beef Wellington and pastries, paired with a variety of fine teas.
